_README: Item 11 (v1.41.0). The FAQ is told in four places that drift independently:
docs/FAQ.md, the Discord responder's FAQ_ENTRIES, the in-game Info library, and
the messages already posted in #scr-faq (which carry docs/FAQ.md's text via a
migration). Nothing failed when they disagreed, so a prose 'checked every
number' table would have decayed into a false verified (#302/#342/#431).
This is that table as a FIXTURE, read by backend/tests/test_faq_surfaces.py.
Each claim names ONE number, the single line of code that decides it, and every
surface that states it. The test re-reads the code, so a knob changed anywhere
turns the suite red instead of leaving four documents quietly wrong.
Fields:
value    the number the code produces, as text
display  how a surface is allowed to write it (defaults to value); present
only where the player-facing unit differs from the code's, e.g. 360
seconds written as '6 minutes'
anchor   {file, pattern}: one regex with ONE capture group that must match
EXACTLY once in that file, and whose capture must equal value
surfaces [{file, text}]: text must appear verbatim in the file, and must
itself contain display - so a surface cannot pass by mentioning the
subject without the number
verdict  'verified' once the surfaces and the anchor agree. 'unknown' is
rejected outright by test_no_claim_unknown: a row nobody resolved is
worse than no row.
